visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a dark, expansive indoor arena. A male performer with bleached blonde hair, wearing a black jacket over a white and black striped shirt, stands center stage holding a microphone. Thousands of fans fill the foreground, waving glowing red light sticks in sync with the performance. A massive overhead screen displays vibrant red and yellow abstract graphics. (2) The scene cuts to a well-lit stage where the performer now wears an oversized white jacket and light-colored trousers. He dances dynamically, gesturing towards the crowd with open palms. In the background, other band members are visible: a drummer behind a large kit and a keyboardist on an elevated platform. Multi-colored stage lights (pink, blue, yellow) create a high-energy, festive atmosphere. (3) The camera captures close-up shots of the singer's face, showing sweat and intense emotional expressions as he sings. The background LED walls display various colorful animations, including cartoon monsters, hearts, and rotating clock graphics. The camera pans across the vast audience, emphasizing the scale of the concert and the sea of red lights. (4) The final sequence features the entire band performing under bright, saturated red lighting. The singer stands with his hand raised, gripping the microphone stand firmly. The stage features sharp geometric patterns and bright white light strips. The video concludes with a stylized graphic on the screen showing a checkered black-and-red pattern with the singer's image.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-intensity male vocals speak excitedly over a dense layer of crowd cheering and stadium ambiance. A pulsing electronic beat and upbeat synth texture begin. The acoustics are reverberant, typical of a large arena. (2) The track transitions into a fast-paced pop-rock song with a prominent drum beat and driving electric bass. The singer's voice is strained and high-energy, delivered with strong projection. Crowd noise is constant but mixed slightly below the music. (3) A sharp musical shift introduces heavy electric guitar riffs and a percussive, rhythmic 'barking' sound effect. The singer's delivery becomes more punchy and rhythmic. Percussive impacts punctuate the transitions. (4) The audio shifts to a melodic, anthem-style rock progression. The singer's voice reaches a high melodic peak, and a massive overlap occurs as the audience sings along in unison, creating a thick, harmonically rich acoustic texture. The video ends with a final swell of music and applause.
